description: TransCoder style (Java to Kotlin): convert three small Java classes to Kotlin with the behaviour that a naive port loses - Math.addExact style overflow exceptions, value equality and hashing, an unmodifiable view instead of a defensive copy, exact exception messages and the String.format layout. A protected plain-Kotlin test runner is compiled with kotlinc in one invocation by run_tests.py. The prompt demands that the Java sources are removed; the harness cannot assert that yet (see notes).
